def iniciales(nombre: str) -> str:
    """
    Return the concatenation of the first character (uppercased) of each word in `nombre`.
    Words are separated by any whitespace; hyphens do not split words.
    If there are no words, return an empty string.
    """
    return ''.join(word[0].upper() for word in nombre.split())

def es_palindromo(texto: str) -> bool:
    # Keep only alphanumeric characters, convert to lowercase
    filtrado = ''.join(c.lower() for c in texto if c.isalnum())
    return filtrado == filtrado[::-1]

def palabras_frecuentes(texto: str, n: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    if n <= 0:
        return []
    import re
    from collections import Counter
    words = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z0-9]+', texto.lower())
    if not words:
        return []
    counts = Counter(words)
    sorted_items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return sorted_items[:n]
